lines.en: I fly over the ridge.
My wingspan is wider than a house.

lines.zh: 我低飞掠过恶地的沟壑。
lines.en: I skim the badlands gullies.

lines.zh: 我的风把沙吹开一条线。
lines.en: My wind parts the sand in a line.
I glide along the cliff wall.

lines.zh: 我投下的阴影盖住半片地。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the ground.
I beat my wings once, slowly.

lines.zh: 我从尖峭山峰之间穿过。
lines.en: I pass between the jagged peaks.
I circle once and come back.
I fly over the clouds above the plains.
I drop lower to look.

lines.zh: 我落在坡顶上，收起翅膀。
lines.en: I land on the ridge and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石，碎石滚下去。
lines.en: I tread the scree and it rolls away.
I rest on a mountaintop.
My wings beat slowly.
The wind crosses my back.

lines.zh: 我看着下面很远的地方。
lines.en: I look at the distance below.
I wait for my tamer's orders.
My metal plates catch the light.
High enough to see clearly.
I am only resting with my wings spread.
My breathing pushes the clouds aside.
I hear an echo in the valley.
I lower my head and tidy my foreclaws.
I spread my wings on the stone.
I listen to the wind in the valley.
You stand below, very small.

lines.zh: 我的翼影扫过你的头顶。
lines.en: My wing shadow sweeps over your head.
Are you coming up?
One beat of my wings makes wind.
When I land, you must move aside.
This mountain is my perch.
If you shout, I will not hear it.
I land, and the wind arrives first.
Your shadow is far smaller than mine.
I am wondering whether to carry you.
The path you climbed was hard.

lines.zh: 我的背上有地方可以坐。
lines.en: There is room to sit on my back.
Keep your hands off my wing bones.
The wind is strong; hold on.
You cut into my shell.
A plate of iron falls off.
I step back and scree slides.
It hurts, but my armor is thick.
I roar and the valley answers.
I straighten myself again.
That one went into my seam.
I can still take off.
Another swing will not split my shell.
I know the smell of scrap.
I lower my head to the scrap pile.
That is not one mouthful for me.
Set it on the pass's heap.
I dip my head and take it.
This metal is a little old.
This pile is not enough to chew.
This will jar my teeth.
There is still oil on your hands.
Is there iron in that pile?
I can swallow a whole plate.
You hit my leg like hitting iron.

lines.zh: 这一下把你弹回去好远。
lines.en: That bounced you back a long way.

lines.zh: 你从我翅膀下面钻过去。
lines.en: You duck under my wing.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，石头都跳起来。
lines.en: We collided and stones leapt.
I move one foot aside slowly.
Steady; I still need to take off.

lines.zh: 我这么大，落脚都要看地。
lines.en: I'm so large I watch where I step.

lines.zh: 我这一身全是从山里捡的。
lines.en: All of this came from the mountains.
I am all scrap iron.

lines.zh: 这副身体只为载重而长。
lines.en: This body grew for carrying loads.
I am the only one on this mountain.
Flying matters more than that.
My head turns away, off you.
My time goes into flying.
I fold my wings and say nothing.
The mountain wind carried that down.
I bite up that piece of scrap iron.
It is small in my mouth.
I toss it onto my back.

lines.zh: 我背上的货箱塞不下了。
lines.en: My cargo bay is full.
I pin it with a foreclaw.
It rolled down the slope.
One bite and it flattens.
Good; into a seam of my armor.
Something is moving down there.
I have the shadow below fixed.
I rise on the ridge.
It is small, but it is moving.
I begin my descent.
My shadow arrives first.
The wind shows me where it is.

lines.zh: 山谷里没有它能躲的石缝。
lines.en: No rock crevice in this valley will hide it.
It has looked up at the sky.
I begin to beat my wings.
Dust flies up from my feet.

lines.zh: 我在它上方的空中跟着。
lines.en: I follow in the air above it.

lines.zh: 它跑向山壁，那里有阴影。
lines.en: It runs for the cliff shade.
I circle lower.
I see its every step.

lines.zh: 我贴得太近，风把它压住。
lines.en: I am so close my wind pins it.
It hides in a rock fissure.
I land at the mouth of the fissure.
It retreats to the very back.
I pry the stone aside.
The distance is right now.
I turn with its heading.
It seeks cover, and finds none.
That split the ground.
It is knocked sliding away.
I raise a claw and press down.

lines.zh: 它砍在我的壳上，崩了刃。
lines.en: It strikes my shell and chips the blade.
I open my mouth and let out a roar.
The sound rolls down the valley.
I beat my wings and the wind knocks it down.
I dive once more.
It rolls into the scree.

lines.zh: 我的爪子把它按进碎石。
lines.en: My claws press it into the gravel.
I set down on the ridge.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀几乎盖住整片坡。
lines.en: My wings cover nearly the whole slope.
Wind funnels up from the valley.
The ridge wind fills my membranes.
First I scan the surroundings.
I know this terrain.
There is smoke far off; perhaps a camp.
I dig my claws into the rock.

lines.zh: 我的影子顺着山坡铺开。
lines.en: My shadow spreads down the slope.
Good; a flight first.
I spread my wings to test them.
The wind here is enough to lift me.

lines.zh: 我朝山谷那边看了一眼。
lines.en: I glance toward the valley.
Scree slides down the slope.

lines.zh: 火焰烧过我身上的废铁。
lines.en: Fire sweeps the scrap on my body.
I crash onto the slope and slide.

lines.zh: 水没到我胸前，我拍着翅膀。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I beat my wings.
The blast tears off a plate.
The arrow bounces off my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的壳缝。
lines.en: That force works into my seams.

lines.zh: 废料吃完了，我的引擎发虚。
lines.en: The scrap is gone and my engine weakens.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的翼上，整片都亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits my wing and it lights up.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，翅膀扇不到风。
lines.en: I fall, my wings finding no air.
